description: Star Chime is an audio-first sequence-memory game: watch four pads glow and sing, then repeat the growing tune across twelve rounds with three lives and two hints per round.
devlog: The fourth arcade ship is an audio-first memory game built on the Web Audio oscillator voice the earlier games introduced, now carrying the melody instead of accenting it. The rules live in a small state machine that only wakes on player input or a single playback timer, so the page rests silent while idle. Twelve rounds quicken the flash from 450ms toward a 280ms floor, three lives forgive slips, and two hints per round replay the next note. Best score rests in a guarded browser key. Lesson one: melody is memory with the lights on. Lesson two: silence between notes matters as much as the notes.
pitch: Hear the tune, repeat the tune. Four pads, twelve rounds, three lives.
title: Star Chime
